name: pyfreerdp-deps
description: Windows build dependencies for pyfreerdp's FreeRDP build (x64-windows, x86-windows, arm64-windows). Core = what every profile needs; 'media' and 'sdl' are pulled in by --profile full.

media.description: FFmpeg (LGPL subset with libopenh264), OpenH264, libusb

sdl.description: SDL3 + SDL3_ttf for the cross-platform sdl-freerdp client
